page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core allocation. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple tests. It achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1842.09 and a multi-core score of 7750.38. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 421.06 GB/sec, which drops to 58.32 GB/sec for large block uncached reads, and a write bandwidth of 41.33 GB/sec. In application-specific benchmarks, the server demonstrates a static web serving throughput of 11.46 GB/sec and processes 7.83 million Redis SET operations per second.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured as a compute-optimized resource. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, though the lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment. This configuration is qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk I/O. It is suited for tasks such as software compilation, web serving, and database operations.
